1928.title: fix(im): cut a chunk on a code-point boundary, not mid-emoji
1928.body:
## What problem this solves

`chunkMarkdown` counts a message in code points (`points(text)` is `Array.from(text).length`) but then uses `limit` as a UTF-16 index for `rest.lastIndexOf(...)` and `rest.slice(...)`. The two units only agree while every character is in the BMP: each astral character (an emoji, most CJK extension characters) is one code point but two UTF-16 units, so a cut taken at `limit` lands one unit early per astral character before it.

Once that drift passes a surrogate pair, `slice` returns a chunk ending on a lone high surrogate and the next chunk starting on a lone low surrogate. Both are invalid on their own, so the emoji is lost in the message the user sees — on every platform that uses `chunkMarkdown` (Discord, QQ, WeCom, DingTalk, and the Slack/Feishu senders).

## How it is fixed

- The cut index comes from `codeUnitIndex(text, limit)`, which walks `limit` code points and returns the matching UTF-16 offset. `points()` and `unitsWithin()` already worked in code points, so the drift is gone at the source rather than patched after the cut.
- The line-then-space preference now compares both separators against the same budget, in the same units: `half = codeUnitIndex(rest, Math.floor(limit / 2))`. Halving the UTF-16 end offset is not the offset of the halfway code point, which could skip a newline the old code would have taken, or take a cut that splits a Markdown link the Slack converter then cannot render.
- The `limit` a caller passes is now explicitly a code-point budget, with an opt-in `{ unit: 'utf16' }` for a platform that counts units. Discord uses it: its 2000 limit is measured in UTF-16 units and a 400 there is permanent, so a chunk of 2000 code points holding emoji would be rejected and stop the rest of the reply. Telegram is left on the default because its limit is documented in characters.
- An earlier version of this branch carried a `pairSafeIndex` helper; it was unreachable (`codeUnitIndex`, `'\n'` and `' '` positions are always code-point boundaries), so it is gone.

## Tests

`test/im-format.test.js`:

- `chunkMarkdown('😀'.repeat(10), 5)` must be two chunks of five emoji, must join back to the input, and no chunk may end on a lone high surrogate or open on a lone low surrogate.
- A mixed `a😀b` message chunked at 20 must keep every code point (`chunks.join('') === body`).

`test/im-discord.test.js` (new): a reply of 1200 emoji plus one ASCII character must reach Discord in messages of at most 2000 units, none starting or ending on half a pair, joining back to the input.

Evidence:

- Red before the fix: `chunkMarkdown('😀'.repeat(10), 5)` fails (`Expected values to be strictly deep-equal`), and the Discord case sends a 2400-unit first message.
- Green after: `im-format` 12/12, `im-discord` 9/9.
- Regression: the IM adapter suites that route through this file (`im-slack`, `im-discord`, `im-feishu`, `im-wecom`, `im-weixin`, `im-qq`, `im-dingtalk`) pass.

## Evidence boundary

- A cut on a code-point boundary can still split a grapheme cluster (ZWJ sequences, flags, skin-tone modifiers). That is out of scope here: the change only stops a cut from landing inside a single code point, which is the level `points()` counts at.
- Local run is node 22 through the repo's `--import ./test/harness-resolve.mjs` runner. Suites that need `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` cannot load here, so they were not run. `npm run lint` is also unavailable on this machine (`no oxlint found`) — CI is the lint evidence.
- Merge note: #2038 changes the Discord `edit` line this PR also touches (`chunkMarkdown(...)` there becomes a helper call). Whichever lands second keeps both: the edit must stay on the last chunk *and* cut in UTF-16 units.

**根因**：主进程的 stdout/stderr 是一根已经没有读端的管道时（Windows 上长时间运行、没挂控制台的 GUI 实例），写入不会同步抛错，而是稍后在 stream 上**异步**触发一个 `error` 事件。`captureStdio`（`app/src/logs.mjs`）只用 try/catch 包了同步写，没给 stream 挂 `error` 监听，这个事件就变成了 `uncaughtException`。

更糟的是，`main.mjs` 里的 `uncaughtException` 处理器会用 `console.error` 记录这个错误，这次写入又往同一根断掉的管道里写，再触发一次 EPIPE，于是主进程陷入 EPIPE → 处理器 → `console.error` → EPIPE 的热循环。electron-updater 默认用 `console` 当 logger，`checkForUpdates()` 打的 "Checking for update" 就是触发点之一，所以 issue 里的调用栈落在 `NsisUpdater.checkForUpdates`。

本机复现（macOS，Node 24，子进程的 stdout/stderr 是管道，父进程收到第一行后把读端关掉，子进程再定时调用 `console.info`，并按 `main.mjs` 的写法挂了 `uncaughtException` 处理器）：
- 修复前：4 秒内处理器被调用约 8.5 万次，每次都是 `write EPIPE`。不加 `captureStdio` 时也一样会循环。
- 修复后：处理器一次都不触发，子进程跑完 20 次 `console.info`，以 0 退出。

**修复**：`captureStdio` 给每个被包装的 stream 挂一个空的 `error` 监听。控制台死掉以后，输出只写进 `main.log`，不再变成未捕获异常。修复放在这一层，是因为这正是 `captureStdio` 本来想处理的情况（原注释："A packaged app on Windows can have no console behind stdout"），只是漏掉了异步失败这条路。electron-updater 和其他任何用 `console` 的代码都一起覆盖到，不需要单独给 updater 配 logger。

**不在这个 PR 里**：0.3.10 已经有 `uncaughtException` 处理器，照理不会弹 Electron 原生的错误框。用户看到弹窗的具体原因（例如当时处理器是否还在）我在 Windows + Electron 上没复现。这个改动让这条路径根本不产生未捕获异常，所以弹窗和热循环都会消失。

## Changelog

桌面版长时间运行后，不会再因为控制台输出管道断开弹出 "write EPIPE" 主进程错误框，也不会因此反复报错占用 CPU。

2258.title: fix(weixin): keep an astral character out of the chunk boundary
2258.body:
## What

`chunk()` in `ds-bot/src/host/im/platforms/weixin.js` cuts the reply at the 1,800-unit limit with `slice(0, at)`. Both the limit and the cut are UTF-16 offsets, so the cut can land between the two halves of an astral character: the first WeChat message ends on a lone high surrogate and the second starts on the lone low surrogate. WeChat draws a replacement character for each half, so one emoji arrives as `��`.

## Why

The other platforms already handle this — `chunkMarkdown` steps back over a high surrogate (`format.js`). Weixin has its own chunker (it counts 1,800 units, not 4,000 characters) and that copy never got the guard. `#1928` fixed the same class of boundary in `format.js`/Discord.

## Fix

After the separator choice, step back one unit when `rest.charCodeAt(at - 1)` is a high surrogate, so the pair travels whole with the next chunk. Nothing else changes: the chunk is still within the limit, the separator preference is untouched, and no character is lost.

```js
const before = rest.charCodeAt(at - 1)
if (at > 1 && before >= 0xd800 && before <= 0xdbff) at -= 1
```

## Evidence

New test `a chunk never ends on half an emoji`: `a` followed by 1,000 emoji — one ASCII character shifts every pair so the 1,800-unit limit falls inside one. It asserts the concatenation is byte-identical to the input, every chunk is ≤1,800 units, and no chunk starts or ends on half a character.

- Before the fix: fails with `a chunk must not end on a lone high surrogate` (24 passed / 1 failed).
- After: `im-weixin.test.js` 25/25; the whole `im-*` suite is 172 passed with one failure in `im-telegram.test.js`, which cannot import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` in this checkout — the same baseline before this change.

## Boundaries

Only the outbound text chunker. Inbound media handling, the `parts`/`ids` bookkeeping and the `dev`-based media helpers are untouched.

2268.title: SWF(bug): fix delivery dedup test cleanup race
2268.body:
Stop the delivery dedup test hosts before deleting their temporary directories. No product behavior changes.

## Issue

The Node 22 cleanup hook failed on [PR #2215](https://github.com/Fei-Craft/DS-Bot/actions/runs/45419041549/job/138533636935) and [on `dev`](https://github.com/Fei-Craft/DS-Bot/actions/runs/45606978988/job/139180431954), where both the retry and concurrent-duplicate cases failed. No matching open issue.

## Agent

Agent: Devin (Cognition)

## What changed / 改了什么

Both fixtures registered directory removal before host shutdown, and Node runs sibling `after` hooks in registration order. Removal could therefore race the runtime’s queued diagnostics and in-flight writes; the `logs` directory remained in all eight reproduced `ENOTEMPTY` failures. Use one async cleanup hook per fixture to await shutdown before removal, keeping cleanup registered before setup.

On Node 22.23.5 (macOS), the same 80-run stress loop (six workers, both affected cases) produced 8 cleanup failures on `dev` and passed all 80 runs with the fix, with no late-write warnings or leftover fixture homes.

seq 80 | xargs -P 6 -I RUN sh -c 'node --import ./test/harness-resolve.mjs --test --test-force-exit --test-name-pattern "a concurrent duplicate|a deferred delivery that failed" test/delivery-dedup.test.js > "$TMPDIR/$1.tap" 2>&1' sh RUN

2229.title: fix(steer): prevent multi-message swallowing on rapid steers and batch queue steering
2229.body: ## Issue Fixes user-reported message swallowing when sending or steering multiple commands/messages rapidly in a Bot's private chat. ## Agent Agent: Antigravity (Gemini 4 Neon) ## What changed / 改了什么 1. **Wait for `agent/assistant-stream` `start` before allowing `STEER_CUT` (`ds-bot/src/host/steer.js`)**: - In DSH `ReactLoopAgent`, `preStep()` calls `inbox.claim()` (removing claimed messages from `agent.inbox`) and emits `step/start` *before* async `prepareRequest()` (`agent/request` + `llm.prepareCall()`) and *before* `session.append('user/message', ...)`. - Previously, `steer.js` set `track.phase = 'model'` on `step/start` and immediately scheduled `agent.cancel(STEER_CUT, { keepInbox: true })`. When a second steer arrived during `preStep` or `prepareRequest`, `step()` aborted before appending `user/message`, permanently swallowing every claimed message in that step. - `steer.js` now tracks `step/start` as `'prepare'` and transitions to `'model'` only on `agent/assistant-stream` `frame.type === 'start'` (after all claimed `user/message` events are durably committed to session history). 2. **Fold rapid steers arriving during the `STEER_CUT` abort window into the active cut batch (`ds-bot/src/host/steer.js`)**: - While a `STEER_CUT` cancellation is unwinding (`wakingAfterAbort === true`), DSH's `ReactLoopAgent.send()` redirects incoming `steer` calls to the tail of `next-turn`, stranding them behind unsteered queued messages or splitting them across extra turns. - `steer.js` tracks active steer-mode `prompt` / `updateQueue` RPCs and folds them synchronously on `agent/inbox/inserted` right after the cut anchor so the next turn claims the full steered batch in FIFO order ahead of unsteered `next-turn` items (while plain `queue`/`followup` prompts remain at the tail). 3. **Atomic batch queue steering (`ds-bot/src/host/steer.js`, `ds-bot/src/host/channel.js`, `ds-bot/src/client/enter-steer.js`, `ds-bot/src/client/team-actions.js`, `ds-bot/src/client/index.js`)**: - Previously, pressing Enter / Cmd+Enter to steer multiple queued messages looped serial `session.updateQueue(id, { kind: 'steer' })` RPCs, racing with `STEER_CUT` between RPCs and causing message loss, reordering, or cascade-cutting across turns. - Added atomic host endpoint `bot-steer-queue` (`rt.steerQueued`) that moves all selected queued user rows together into `next-step` (or folds them into an active cut batch) in a single turn of the event loop, with clean fallback to per-row `updateQueue` for non-Bot sessions or older hosts. 4. **Real DSH contract tests (`ds-bot/test/steer-loop.test.js`, `ds-bot/test/steer.test.js`, `ds-bot/test/enter-steer.test.js`)**: - 2245.title: fix: 保存团队状态时先落盘再替换，死机后重启不再丢失全部 Bot 和群聊
2245.body:
<!--
Base branch: dev. Hotfixes and releases only: main.
目标分支选 dev。只有热修和发版才选 main。
-->

## Issue

Refs #2238

#2238 的描述很少（死机时有 Bot 在跑任务，重启后 Bot 和群聊都没了）。这个 PR 修的是一条会产生完全相同症状、而且在代码里能确认存在的路径。但报告里没有日志，我没法确认用户遇到的就是这一条，所以写的是 Refs，没有写 Fixes。维护者如果认定是同一个问题，可以改成 Fixes。

## Agent

Agent: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

## What changed / 改了什么

**问题**：团队状态（`state.json`，包含所有 Bot 和群聊）的保存方式是先写临时文件，再 rename 覆盖 `state.json`（`src/host/store.js` 的 `queueWrite`），但临时文件写完**没有 fsync**。整个 `ds-bot/src` 里都没有调用 fsync。

机器死机或断电时，rename 这一步可能已经落盘，文件内容却还没写进去，重启后就会得到一个空的 `state.json`。`readFileState` 解析失败后会把它备份成 `state.json.broken-*`，然后**按空团队启动**：所有 Bot 和群聊看起来都没了，而那份备份也是空文件，没法用来恢复。这和 #2238 的描述一致。

**修复**：临时文件改用 `writeFile(temp, snapshot, { encoding: 'utf8', flush: true })` 写入。`flush` 会在关闭文件前 fsync，数据落盘之后才做 rename，所以不管什么时候崩溃，磁盘上的 `state.json` 要么是旧的完整版本，要么是新的完整版本。DSH 要求 Node ≥ 24.9，`flush` 选项从 Node 21 开始支持。

**代价**：每次保存多一次 fsync。保存本来就排队合并（同一时间最多一次写盘），在 SSD 上这点开销可以忽略。

**不在这个 PR 里**：
- 其他同样是"写临时文件再 rename"的文件（换段交接记录、记忆等）。这次只改了承载整个团队的 `state.json`，其他文件丢了影响小得多。
- 没有对目录做 fsync。最坏情况是 rename 本身丢失，这时留下的是上一份完整的 `state.json`，不会是空文件。
- 读到空文件或坏文件时"按空团队启动"的现有行为没有改。

## Changelog

保存 Bot 团队时先把数据写到磁盘再替换文件，避免死机或断电后重启时 Bot 和群聊全部消失。

## What changed / 改了什么

Packaged `DS Bot.app` builds and default/legacy shell directories stay on the real login keychain unless `--use-mock-keychain` is passed explicitly.
